server-config.clientId_comment: Client ID of the OAuth 2.0 client registration created in Launchpad Studio > Administration setup
server-config.clientSecret_comment: Keep empty for authCode; if your registration is Confidential, enter it locally and do not commit it
server-config.redirectUri_comment: Same redirect URL the website project uses; it is already registered on this OAuth client and proven to work. Stop 'npm start' first (both use port 6006).
server-config.cert_and_key_comment: Pega's development certificate for the local https://localhost:4010 login page (copied from the DXCB project template)
